newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Fletcher Challenge Cda debt.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Fletcher Challenge Cda debt.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Thursday it confirmed Fletcher Challenge Canada Ltd senior debt rating at BBB (high) with a stable trend.
In addition, the agency said it confirmed Fletcher Challenge Canada's commercial paper rating at R-1 (low), also with a stable trend.

"Although prices and earnings have peaked for this forestry cycle, the balance sheet is expected to remain very strong. The potential divestiture of the investment in TimberWest Forest Ltd would also significantly add to the company's financial flexibility," DBRS said.
